Your holdings: SOXL (-34.93%) and SPAL (-34.04%) are flagged for attention. These leveraged ETFs are bleeding and margin amplifies the pain. CRWD (50.05%) and METU (50.86%) are your big winners.

Watch: Keep an eye on the 30-year Treasury yield and any further Fed commentary.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and protecting your gains in the current rate environment.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or stopping out given the -34.93% loss and leveraged decay, especially with rising rates.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or stopping out due to the -34.04% loss and leveraged decay.
AAPL: Scanner shows a BUY setup (entry 336.19-335.86, stop 334.96). Consider if this aligns with your risk tolerance.
